proposal.expected_reason: On F_competition, the spt rule will produce a verified complete-batch makespan at or near the CP-SAT optimum of 63s, because the RINSE chamber is the nominal bottleneck (load 28s vs 4s) and spt prioritizes short jobs, reducing blocking-to-processing ratio (0.957) on that chamber.

Remaining value is in the secondary lexicographic criterion (tool/wall cost) and in testing whether cheap rules can match the optimum. Untried rules on F are fifo, spt, ect; spt is the most plausible to approach the RINSE-dominated optimum since shortest-processing-time prioritization tends to reduce blocking on the bottleneck chamber. This is a low-cost probe (~0.3s) well within the 469s wall budget.
